SELECT DISTINCT PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_ID id, PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_ID || ':' || PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_NAME text FROM PTL_PORTFOLIO LEFT JOIN PTL_CAPACCT_INFO ON PTL_CAPACCT_INFO.PORTFOLIO_ID = PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_ID
INVEST_YESORNO = 'Y' AND PORTFOLIO_TYPE = #{PORTFOLIO_TYPE_01} AND PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_ID != #{transferPortfolioId} AND PTL_CAPACCT_INFO.ACCT_NO = (SELECT DISTINCT PCI.ACCT_NO FROM PTL_CAPACCT_INFO PCI WHERE PCI.ACCT_TYPE = #{ACCT_TYPE_A01} AND PCI.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{transferPortfolioId})
AND (PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_ID LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{search,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%') OR PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_NAME LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{search,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%'))
AND PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{initValue}
AND PTL_PORTFOLIO.MDATE > to_date(#{sysDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')

with maxdate as ( select MAX(t.EFF_DATE) EFF_DATE,t.CASH_ID from FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE t where t.EFF_DATE <=to_date(#{tradeDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') group by t.CASH_ID) select fccr.EFF_DATE, fccr.BASIS, fccr.YIELD, fcp.VDATE from FIN_CASH_PLAN fcp, FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE fccr inner join maxdate on maxdate.CASH_ID = fccr.CASH_ID and maxdate.EFF_DATE = fccr.EFF_DATE where fcp.CASH_ID = fccr.CASH_ID and fcp.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} and fcp.VDATE <= to_date(#{tradeDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') and fcp.MDATE > to_date(#{tradeDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')

SELECT AD.PROD_REGIST_CODE FROM FIN_PRODUCT FIN LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD AD ON FIN.FINPROD_ID = AD.FINPROD_ID
FIN.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{portfolioId} AND FIN.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{finprodType2}
